entity_name.description: Find notes that mention this named entity (case-insensitive)

entity_type.description: Optional entity type filter when using entity_name (e.g. technology, organisation)

note_type.description: Filter by note type: semantic, episodic, reflection, consolidated, news, news_raw, outcome. Without a query, ENUMERATES all notes of this type by date.

source_context.description: The label a set of notes was filed under (e.g. 'resume', 'video_learning', 'daily_brief'). WITHOUT a `query` this ENUMERATES every note carrying that source_context (chunk fragments excluded) and returns a `complete` flag — this is how you retrieve a whole multi-note document. With a `query` it only narrows the ranked search. An enumeration that matches NOTHING returns `available_note_types` / `available_source_contexts` — the labels that actually exist. Retry with one of those; never report absence off a zero here, and never guess a third label without reading that list.

limit.description: Max number of results (default: 5). Raise it when enumerating — a multi-note document needs a limit above its note count for `complete` to come back true.

graph_hops.description: RELATES_TO hops to expand text-search results (default: 2, 0 to disable)

entity_expansion.description: Also surface notes that share named entities with text-search results (default: false)
